_help: Edit this to change how the council runs, then: python council.py "your question" --config council.config.json  (or use run.ps1 / run.sh). The Claude-only inline method does NOT use this file. provider options: fusion (the named crew, recommended) | ollama (free, local, no key) | groq | openrouter | gemini | openai | anthropic | auto.

_example_fusion_crew._note: The default crew. Each job lists its owner FIRST, then who covers it if that model is rate-limited or retired — always the next smartest, never a cheaper tier. Omit `crew` entirely to use these built-in defaults. Every model runs at high reasoning effort.
